exposure: type of delivery (vaginal or caesarean section)
cohort: 500 recently delivered women who delivered vaginally or by caesarean section in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology in the Bihar region of India.
finding: 70% of women initiated breastfeeding within 1 hour of delivery, and maternal age, sex of child, religion, area of residence, and type of delivery were identified as factors determining initiation, while maternal educational status, employment, socioeconomic status, ANC visits, and antenatal counselling were associated factors.
mod_finding: Type of delivery (vaginal or caesarean section) was identified as a factor determining the initiation of breastfeeding.
